pages.main_text: Our Story Family-Owned. Northern NSW. Since 1987. Cham's was founded in a Goonellabah garage in 1985 and incorporated as a smallgoods manufacturer in 1987. Today the company runs a 60-staff processing facility in Lismore and supplies independent retailers and hospitality providers throughout New South Wales. Fig. 01 The Bellanova family, southern Italy, c.1962. Cham (highlighted, front) with his parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins outside the family home in Calabria. The recipes the company makes today were the recipes the family ate every weekend. Vol. 04 · Forty Years A Brief Timeline 1983 Cham Bellanova arrives in Australia from southern Italy with his father's recipes. 1985 Begins making salami in his garage in Goonellabah for neighbours. 1987 Cham's Small Meats & Preservatives Pty Ltd is founded. 1994 Moves into the first dedicated facility on Industrial Drive, Lismore. 2003 Son Marco Bellanova joins production. 2011 Daughter Lucia Bellanova takes on operations and trade. 2018 Facility expansion — second curing house commissioned. 2024 60 staff. Supplying 320+ stockists across NSW & QLD. Photographed in the original curing house, May 2024. A Word from the Founder In Cham's Own Words. "When I come to Australia in 1983 I didn't know nobody. I had my father's recipes and I had two hands. I start making salami in my garage for the neighbours. They say Cham, this is good, you should sell this . So I sell it. Forty year later we still make everything the same way. Good meat, proper curing, no shortcut. My son work with me now. My daughter do the office. She tell me I need website, I need social media. I say OK, but the salami is the same. People ask me why I don't change the name. Small Meats & Preservatives, they say it sound old fashioned. I say, that's what we make. Why I'm going to call it something else. We do it properly. That's it. That's the whole business." — Cham Bellanova, Founder Our Values Honest Ingredients. Time-Honoured Methods. — 01 Australian Ingredients Pork sourced from accredited Australian farms. Salt from Pyramid Salt in northern Victoria. No imported fillers. — 02 Naturally Cured Slow, cool curing at controlled humidity. No accelerants. Some products take twelve weeks before they leave the curing house. — 03 Family Operated Cham still runs production. His son Marco is on the floor. His daughter Lucia runs operations. We answer the phone.

Our Story

Family-Owned. Northern NSW. Since 1987.

Cham's was founded in a Goonellabah garage in 1985 and incorporated as a smallgoods manufacturer in 1987. Today the company runs a 60-staff processing facility in Lismore and supplies independent retailers and hospitality providers throughout New South Wales.

Fig. 01
The Bellanova family,
southern Italy, c.1962.

Cham (highlighted, front) with his parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins outside the family home in Calabria. The recipes the company makes today were the recipes the family ate every weekend.

Vol. 04 · Forty Years

A Brief Timeline

1983

Cham Bellanova arrives in Australia from southern Italy with his father's recipes.

1985

Begins making salami in his garage in Goonellabah for neighbours.

1987

Cham's Small Meats & Preservatives Pty Ltd is founded.

1994

Moves into the first dedicated facility on Industrial Drive, Lismore.

2003

Son Marco Bellanova joins production.

2011

Daughter Lucia Bellanova takes on operations and trade.

2018

Facility expansion — second curing house commissioned.

2024

60 staff. Supplying 320+ stockists across NSW & QLD.

Photographed in the original curing house, May 2024.
A Word from the Founder

In Cham's Own Words.

"When I come to Australia in 1983 I didn't know nobody. I had my father's recipes and I had two hands. I start making salami in my garage for the neighbours. They say Cham, this is good, you should sell this. So I sell it.

Forty year later we still make everything the same way. Good meat, proper curing, no shortcut. My son work with me now. My daughter do the office. She tell me I need website, I need social media. I say OK, but the salami is the same.

People ask me why I don't change the name. Small Meats & Preservatives, they say it sound old fashioned. I say, that's what we make. Why I'm going to call it something else.

We do it properly. That's it. That's the whole business."

— Cham Bellanova, Founder
Our Values

Honest Ingredients. Time-Honoured Methods.

— 01

Australian Ingredients

Pork sourced from accredited Australian farms. Salt from Pyramid Salt in northern Victoria. No imported fillers.

— 02

Naturally Cured

Slow, cool curing at controlled humidity. No accelerants. Some products take twelve weeks before they leave the curing house.

— 03

Family Operated

Cham still runs production. His son Marco is on the floor. His daughter Lucia runs operations. We answer the phone.

Community & Environment

Committed to the Place We Operate.

Cham's is a Northern NSW business, and the place we operate matters to us. We are committed to responsible environmental management at our Lismore facility and to supporting community partners who do meaningful work in our region.

Community Partner · Since 2019

Dam Kings Beach

Cham's is a founding sponsor of the Dam Kings Beach initiative, a community-led project working to maintain and improve public-access waterways in our region. We provide annual financial support and donate to their seasonal community events.

damkingsbeach.org

"We been here forty year. The river, the beach, all this — it's our community. You support the community, the community support you. That's how it works."

— Cham Bellanova
Operations

Environmental Management

Water

Waste

Trim and bone by-product diverted to local agricultural use. Plastic and cardboard packaging waste sorted for recycling on-site.

Energy

Rooftop solar (148 kW) installed 2022. Refrigeration retro-fitted to natural-refrigerant condensers.

Salami & Soppressa

Hot Soppressa

1 kg whole Batch · HS-26-04

Our hot soppressa is made to a traditional southern-Italian recipe passed down from Cham's father. Coarse-cut Australian pork shoulder is blended with cracked fennel seed and dried chilli flakes, then stuffed into natural casings and hung in our curing house for a minimum of eight weeks. The result is a firm, intensely flavoured salami with a slow, building heat that pairs well with aged cheeses and crusty bread.

Ingredients
Australian pork (85%), salt, dried chilli flakes, fennel seed, garlic, dextrose, black pepper, starter culture, sodium nitrate.
Curing
Minimum 8 weeks natural air-cured
Storage
Refrigerate at 0–4°C. Once opened, consume within 14 days.

Phosphate Blend (STP)

Sodium Erythorbate

Preservatives

Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT)

20 kg pail Batch · BH-26-01

Butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT) is a synthetic antioxidant used to prevent oxidative rancidity in fats, oils, and rendered products. It extends the shelf life of products containing animal fats by inhibiting the chain reaction of lipid oxidation. Commonly used in lard, tallow, and rendered cooking fats, as well as in the fat component of processed meat products. Supplied in a sealed 20 kg food-grade pail.

Ingredients
Butylated hydroxytoluene (100%).
Curing
N/A — antioxidant
Storage
Store in a cool, dry place away from heat sources. Keep sealed when not in use.

variants.main_text: Family-Owned Smallgoods · Lismore NSW Honest Ingredients. Time-Honoured Methods. Cham's Small Meats & Preservatives has been producing traditional cured meats for the Australian market since 1987. Made the same way for nearly forty years, supplied to independent retailers and hospitality providers across NSW. View Our Range Our Story EST · 1987 HACCP Certified — Cham Bellanova, Founder Vol. 02 · Our Range Featured Products Salami, soppressa, cured cuts, preserved goods, and food-grade preservatives. Available in retail packs and bulk for hospitality. See all products → Hot Soppressa 1 kg whole Naturally cured with chilli and fennel. Coarse-cut, traditional southern-Italian style. Batch · HS-26-04 Detail Mild Soppressa 1 kg whole The classic Calabrian recipe, made without heat. Slow-cured for ten weeks. Batch · MS-26-04 Detail Cacciatore 4 × 80 g Hunter-style salami, sized to fit a back pocket. Sold in packs of four. Batch · CC-26-04 Detail Vol. 03 · The Cham's Way Same Recipes. Same Standards. Forty Years On. Every batch we produce begins with Cham's father's recipes, brought from southern Italy in 1983. Forty years on, the only things that have changed are the size of the building and the number of hands. The meat, the curing, the time it takes — all the same. Honest. Ingredients sourced from Australian producers we've worked with for decades. Time-Honoured. Naturally cured, never rushed. Some batches take twelve weeks. Properly. Specifications, batch numbers, and a phone number that rings. For Trade · Wholesale & Hospitality Stocked in independent grocers, delis & restaurants across NSW. We supply independent retailers, butchers, delicatessens, and hospitality providers in retail packs and food-service bulk. Minimum order quantities apply. Standard delivery weekly across the Lismore–Byron–Tweed catchment; cold-chain freight statewide. Wholesale Enquiries Download Specs (PDF) "Cham's has supplied our deli for fourteen years. Consistent product, consistent batch sizes, never a missed delivery. We don't need to think about it." JP Joseph Pellegrini Pellegrini's Continental, Newcastle

Same Recipes. Same Standards. Forty Years On.
